title: Anamika
desc: A writer saves an injured woman who has lost her memory and insists she is his wife. While searching for her true identity, he slowly falls in love with her for real.

title: Darlings
desc: Hamza and Badru's love marriage spirals into abuse and alcoholism. When his cruelty sparks a tragedy, Badru transforms her pain into power and sets out for revenge.

title: Vedaa
desc: Vedaa, facing caste discrimination, trains as a boxer under Abhimanyu to seek justice for her siblings' murder, fighting both societal bias and the killers with courage and determination.

title: Aparichit-The Stranger
desc: Ramanujam, a lawyer with multiple personalities, turns vigilante at night. Guided by Garuda Purana, he hunts down criminals and exposes antisocial elements in society.

title: I Want To Talk
desc: Arjun, a marketing executive in America, struggles with his daughter. His life changes when he is diagnosed with throat cancer, forcing him to confront relationships, words, and mortality.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Tejas
desc: Brave IAF officer Tejas undertakes a perilous mission to rescue an Indian spy from deep inside Pakistan, all while battling enemies outside-and haunting memories within.

title: Shikar
desc: Manager Ajay Singh reports a murder. Evidence is tampered. He meets Kiran, who has crucial clues to find the killer.

title: The Hero: Love Story Of A Spy
desc: Arun, an Indian spy, falls for Reshma. When she disappears during a mission, he vows revenge and sets out to punish those responsible.

title: Karz
desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

title: Gully Boy
desc: Murad, an underdog from Dharavi, struggles to express his reality and social issues through rap, until meeting local rapper MC Sher, whose guidance transforms his confidence and dreams.

title: Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh
desc: As Inspector Inderjeet investigates the car accident, he discovers that Vidya Sinha may not be all she appears. She has a dark past linking her to Durga Rani Singh.

title: The Kerala Story
desc: A former nursing student from Kerala becomes a terrorist's wife. She recounts her journey from innocence to radicalisation, revealing the dark truth behind her transformation.

title: Ajay
desc: Manorama falls in love with Ajay, even though they come from different social backgrounds. They want to get married, but Manorama's uncles try their best to separate the happy couple.
